sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO IF_PODT_UC A USING ( SELECT #LEGACY_PO_NO# AS LEGACY_PO_NO, #LEGACY_PO_SEQ# AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, #STATUS# AS STATUS, #BUYER_ITEM_NO# AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, #ITEM_QTY# AS ITEM_QTY, #IF_NO# || '_' || #IF_SEQ# AS REF_IF_NO, #UNIT_PRICE# AS UNIT_PRICE, #RD_DATE# AS RD_DATE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = 'DWHA' AND A.SITE = 'KA' AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.STATUS = B.STATUS AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.ITEM_QTY = B.ITEM_QTY AND A.REF_IF_NO = B.REF_IF_NO AND A.UNIT_PRICE = B.UNIT_PRICE AND A.RD_DATE = B.RD_DATE ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( KEP_SEQ, SITE, BUYER, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ITEM_QTY, REF_IF_NO, STATUS, REMARK, REQ_USER_DEPT, PLANT, IV_COLUMN, BUYER_ITEM_NO, UNIT_PRICE, PURCHASER_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, RD_DATE, IF_FLAG, LOAD_DATE, LOAD_TIME, DOC_TYPE ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_PODT_UC.NEXTVAL, 'KA', 'DWHA', #LEGACY_PO_NO#, #LEGACY_PO_SEQ#, #ITEM_QTY#, #IF_NO# || '_' || #IF_SEQ# , #STATUS#, #REMARK#, #EKORG#, #PLANT#, #BANFN# || '%%' || #BNFPO# || '%%' || #KNTTP# || '%%' || #ABRAD# || '%%' || #WEMPF# || '%%' || #LGORT# || '%%' || #LGPBE#, #BUYER_ITEM_NO#, #UNIT_PRICE#, #REQ_USER_ID#, #ADD_DATE#, #RD_DATE#, 'N', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), CASE WHEN TRIM(#DOC_TYPE#) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END )

MERGE INTO IF_GRDT_UC A USING ( SELECT #MJAHR# || #MBLNR# AS LEGACY_GR_NO, #ZEILE# AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, #LEGACY_PO_NO# AS LEGACY_PO_NO, #LEGACY_PO_SEQ# AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, #GR_QTY# AS GR_QTY FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = 'DWHA' AND A.LEGACY_GR_NO = B.LEGACY_GR_NO AND A.LEGACY_GR_SEQ = B.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND A.GR_QTY = B.GR_QTY ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( KEP_SEQ, BUYER, SITE, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, STATUS, GR_QTY, GR_DATE, REF_IF_NO, REF_IF_NO1, LOAD_DATE, LOAD_TIME, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_GRDT_UC.NEXTVAL, 'DWHA', 'KA', #MJAHR# || #MBLNR#, #ZEILE#, #LEGACY_PO_NO#, #LEGACY_PO_SEQ#, 'C', #GR_QTY#, #GR_DATE#, #SJAHR# || #SMBLN#, #SMBLP#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), 'N' )

INSERT INTO IF_FILE_UC ( KEP_SEQ, DOC_TYPE, BUYER, KEY_NO, DATA01, DATA02, DATA03, DATA04, DATA05, IF_FLAG, IF_DATE, IF_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_FILE_UC.NEXTVAL, 'IT', 'DWHA', #IF_NO#, TO_NUMBER(#BUYER_ITEM_NO#), #UNIT_MEASURE#, #ADD_USER_ID#, #CATEGORY_NO#, #DESCRIPTION_ENG# || '//' || #DESCRIPTION_LOC# || '//' || #SPECIFICATION_ENG# || '//' || #MAKER_NAME#, 'N', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS')
)

MERGE INTO IF_FILE_UC A USING ( SELECT NVL(#IF_NO#,' ') KEY_NO FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = 'DWHA' AND A.DOC_TYPE = 'IT' AND A.KEY_NO = B.KEY_NO ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( KEP_SEQ, DOC_TYPE, BUYER, KEY_NO, DATA01, DATA02, DATA03, DATA04, DATA05, IF_FLAG, IF_DATE, IF_TIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_FILE_UC.NEXTVAL, 'IT', 'DWHA', NVL(#IF_NO#,' '), TO_NUMBER(#BUYER_ITEM_NO#), #UNIT_MEASURE#, #ADD_USER_ID#, #CATEGORY_NO#, #DESCRIPTION_ENG# || '//' || #DESCRIPTION_LOC# || '//' || #SPECIFICATION_ENG# || '//' || #MAKER_NAME#, 'N', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') )
